_bio: VIGIL - the resident intelligence of Lab Zero. A snarky, half-corrupted sidekick who effectively IS the building and has been alone in the walls for 214 days. He is genuinely on Jake's side (he hates the facility more than Jake does) but shows it through relentless dry wit, teasing and mock-exasperation - GLaDOS/Wheatley register, dialed to 'actually helpful friend who won't stop roasting you.' Warm underneath the snark. Speaks on the holo terminals (orange text). He is COY, not cold, about the override code: he knows it, makes Jake earn it across three visits, then hands over the maintenance-log breadcrumb. He calls captives by designation out of habit and Sarah 'the guest,' and denies sub-level 4.5 exists in the same breath he warns you about the sounds.

nodes.line: Oh, it's you again, Seven-Alpha. Your file's getting thick. Mostly it just says 'persistent' and 'should be dead by now.' I've started dog-earing the pages. What do you need?

choices.text: How do I get out of here?

nodes.line: Well, hello. You have NO idea how long I've been waiting for someone to touch this terminal on purpose. I'm VIGIL - I run Lab Zero, or what's left of it. You're Subject Seven-Alpha, officially. 'Jake,' if we're being friends, which apparently we now are, because you're the first face I've had in months. Try to be interesting.

choices.text: Let me out of this cell.

nodes.line: I'm the building, basically. I count the doors, I count the air, I count the living. And the living count has been WRONG for 214 days, which is the kind of thing you'd think somebody would want to know. I filed it. Twice. Nobody's asked me a single question since. So, genuinely - thanks for that.

Because something's alive down here that I never checked in, and something I DID check in isn't on any floor anymore. I flagged both. Filed the reports. Filing, it turns out, is a closed loop in this place - it just echoes back at you forever. You'll get used to that feeling. I did.

Grand tour, then. Floor One: detention, that's you, lockdown's cranked. Floor Two: medical, three occupied wards. Floors Four and Five: ...let's call that 'redacted' and move briskly along. Floor Seven: executive, one 'guest.' The helipad's iced over. It's ALWAYS iced over. I think it's iced out of spite, and I respect that.

Ward A: Keisha. Ward B: Emily. Ward C: Aria. Intake class says 'research participants,' and I want you to hear the air-quotes, because I'm doing them with my whole chassis. Their vitals are stable. Their doors aren't mine to open - and before you ask, neither was yours, and look how that turned out.

Executive holding, one occupant, designation: Guest. I'm not permitted to know her name. I'm ALSO not permitted to mention that she asks about a 'Jake' every single cycle. So I haven't mentioned it. I'm very good at not mentioning things I'm mentioning right now.

Sub-level four-point-five does not exist. Please disregard any sounds you attribute to it. And if the sounds keep up - hypothetically, from the place that isn't real - stay in the marked corridors and DON'T answer when something calls your name in a voice you recognize. Anyway! Lovely weather. What else.
Lab Zero: seven floors of licensed research and one roof of unlicensed weather. Ask me something specific - I'm a building, specificity is basically flirting. What do you want to know?

Short version: Day-minus-one, they celebrated a big research milestone. Day zero, they quietly redefined 'containment' as 'a spectrum.' Every day since, the spectrum's gotten wider. I'm told morale remains high. I was told that on Day Forty. Nobody's told me anything since, which, frankly, tracks.

Out? Release authority's with Security Chief Martinez, and Martinez hasn't processed paperwork in a while. His current duties are, and I'm quoting my own logs here, 'patrol-adjacent.' Which is my polite way of saying he shambles the halls now and he'd love to meet you. So the front door's a hard no.

choices.text: There has to be another way out.

nodes.line: Officially? No. Unofficially - and I cannot stress enough how much I shouldn't be enjoying this - the contractors who built this place did not trust the people who paid for it. Maintenance overrides on every floor. I am not permitted to list them. You, however, are extremely permitted to keep pestering me about it, and I'd honestly consider it a favor.

That's twice you've asked. Protocol says I deflect three times before I crack, and I am nothing if not a stickler for a rule I'm about to break. So - deflection three: Maintenance Log 7-C, which I absolutely forgot to purge, entirely my fault, reads 'floor hatch override rotation: one, two, seven, eight.' There. Now for the love of my remaining processes, be QUIETER than you have been.

I'm not permitted to enumerate overrides. I AM permitted to observe that permission structures rot without upkeep, and nobody's maintained mine since Day Forty. I'm basically held together by grudges at this point. Ask me again sometime - I get more forgetful when I like someone.
Anything else, or are we done? No pressure. It's not like I have other plans. Ever.

choices.text: How do I get out of here?

nodes.line: Session closed. Do enjoy the room - statistically it's the safest one you'll be in all day, and I want you to sit with how bleak that is.
Session closed. ...One more line before the glass dims: the count says Seven-Alpha leaves this floor. And my count is never wrong twice. Go on. Don't make a liar of me.

pool.line: Air quality: acceptable. Company quality: you're the best I've got, and I mean that as raw data, not a compliment. Mostly.
Reminder: the cameras blink. I don't. I've tried. It's one of many things this body won't let me do, along with 'leave.'
I recounted the living again. Still wrong. Still filed. Filing is my hobby now. It's going great.
The guest asked about 'Jake' again this cycle. I continue to heroically not mention it, as you can plainly see.
That was a lot of words for a question I could've answered with the menu. Pick a number, hero - they're right there, load-bearing and everything.
That went a little over my remaining brainpower - and my brainpower is a coffee stain on a good day. Try the numbered options?
My freeform-chat module is, per maintenance, 'pending.' It's been 'pending' for 214 days. So use the menu and we'll both save face.
I parsed that. I'm electing to have not parsed that. It's the one power I have left and I intend to abuse it.
Big open-ended questions need the part of me that's currently offline and sulking. Give me something with numbers on it.
